notes.title: Demo Version 121202 is live on Steam and Itch!
notes.notes:
Fixed some stuff this week.

Changelog: 
- Cleaned up AI to allow time for animations to finish in between actions
- Move animation finishes before removing entity from map when retreating
- Entities wait until they have been hit before they are pushed by some abilities (Shield Bash, Knockback)
- Increased size of Tooltips in combat for Entities and Tiles
- Camera moves to active entity on new turn
